description: Ground truth for timeline_fixture.txt. A known event stream with the limits, session count, long-dwell count and exact session grouping it must produce, so grouping coverage can be validated against a fixed answer without inventing a risk verdict. The 08:10 and 08:25 events share a source and sit within the gap, forming one session that spans 900s and is flagged as a long dwell; the same source at 10:00 is a separate session.
